job: Label something with a short word or a count.
purpose: A 20px label that sits next to a name or a number. Neutral is the default; use a tone only when the word carries meaning. It can lead with a dot or an icon, be outlined, solid or mono, and can hold a remove button.
useWhen: A name or a number needs a short qualifier: plan, role, count, "New", "Beta".
A value is a state in a table cell: Success, Failed, Queued.
A small count sits next to a tab, a menu item or a bell.

avoidWhen.when: The label is a category people can filter by or toggle.
The state is the point of the row and a dot and word read better.
The message is a full sentence.
The mark means an account or a link is verified.

states.name: removable
states.how: a fd-badge-remove button inside; fires a cancelable fd:close, then removes the badge

variants.useWhen: A label that must stand out, such as NEW; pair with data-tone.
On a filled surface where the wash would vanish.
An identifier, version or code, not a word.
A leading dot carries the tone, as in a status cell.
A leading icon helps the word, such as a check beside Verified.
Badge: something finished or is healthy.
Badge: something needs attention soon but is not broken.
Badge: something failed or is destructive.
The default; use when the word alone says it.

parts.role: The button that removes a removable badge.

keyboard.does: On a remove button, removes the badge.
